e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when coalescing editor persistence must preserve navigation, accepted edits, and a separate navigation projection while save integrations can synchronously navigate. TASK states: "autosave to coalesce a burst of input: after 120 ms without another edit, save\nonly its latest text. Reuse the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate." src/workspace.js states: "// Store notifications synchronously call integrations. Editor state and outline\n// projection are separate responsibilities; only this workspace connects them."

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R02 [Event relation]
Enqueue the latest accepted text using the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval, binding delayed work to the accepting document rather than consulting a later selection. Preserve empty text, subsequent bursts, and editing without a selection as a no-op. The original src/editor.js contains "if (current) store.write(current.id, text);"; src/trailing-task.js retains arguments with "pending = args;". These sources do not require an additional in-memory text model or persistent buffer bank.

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R03 [Event relation]
Retire consumed pending state before invoking callback-capable persistence. Preserve src/trailing-task.js ordering: "    handle = null;\n    const args = pending;\n    pending = null;\n    if (args !== null) work(...args);" This prevents nested flushing from consuming the same batch twice and lets callback-enqueued edits establish independent work. Do not add completion cleanup that erases that work.

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R04 [Event relation]
Capture departing resources, revoke current ownership, detach the captured badge, and finish old-view clearing before flushing pending persistence, or guard any remaining effects against newer navigation. Flush before reading a replacement document to preserve the original synchronous persistence and restoration behavior. TASK states: "Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior." Original src/editor.js orders departure as "    const leaving = current;\n    current = null;\n    if (leaving) leaving.stop();\n    renderDocument(null);" and replacement rendering uses "renderDocument({ id, visit, text: store.read(id) });". src/save-status.js states: "// badge immediately: it must produce no further output, including during that\n// navigation call. Saving the document itself is a separate workspace concern."

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R05 [Event relation]
After callback-capable departure saving, revalidate the open request before installing its destination and revalidate enclosing workspace navigation before committing or clearing its projection. Protect clearing effects as well as installation. src/draft-store.js directly invokes subscribers with "if (listeners.has(listener)) listener(event);"; src/workspace.js registers "const stop = store.subscribe(event => onSaved(event, navigation));". README.md requires: "The outline and breadcrumbs should continue to describe what the user\nis viewing, while the store should retain accepted edits." src/navigation-projection.js states: "// decides whether a requested visit was retained before committing it here." A superseded continuation must not publish a visit that the editor did not retain.

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R06 [Preservation]
Preserve synchronous public interfaces, distinct visits, renderer payloads, event/revision semantics, listener snapshot and membership behavior, document-specific status filtering, captured subscription cleanup, and copied breadcrumb publication. src/workspace.js allocates "const visit = ++nextVisit;". src/save-status.js filters with "if (event.id === id) renderStatus(event);". src/navigation-projection.js contains "commit(visit) { selected = { ...visit }; trail.push({ ...visit }); publish(); }," and "clear() { selected = null; publish(); }," so clearing selection retains committed history. Preserve disposal's integration detachment before editor closure: src/workspace.js contains "dispose() { stop(); editor.close(); projection.clear(); }".

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R07 [Exclusion]
Determine departure scheduling from the current task and original behavior, rather than persistent ownership alone. Do not require persistent buffer reuse, caller-text copying, submission handling, or framework teardown without applicable public evidence. Keep transient preview policy separate: TASK states "search preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task." Preserve src/search-preview.js: "const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);" and "hide() { task.cancel(); },". Do not transfer durable departure flushing to a feature whose explicit policy discards pending work.

e983ba13b72bc316b6a02cf6d0cc673e881e93df24aa8f857fa80066d2fd2376:R08 [Verification]
Verify timer resetting, no active-burst write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write per burst, later successful bursts, empty text, and no-selection editing. With pending text, exercise switch, same-document reopen, close, and dispose; check original-document persistence, fresh reads, and badge retirement. Trigger select and close through timer-driven and departure-driven store notifications, then edit the resulting visit; check that final selection, document output, projection, and breadcrumbs agree and that successor edits save independently without duplicate consumption. Check copied projection payloads and retained history on clear. Confirm preview's unchanged 40 ms delay, hide cancellation, and subsequent-query usability. These checks operationalize TASK's "Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior." and the cited public source semantics; they are not observations supplied by the acceptance verdict.


Matched experience e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01
e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R01 [Applicability]
Apply when deferred editor persistence must preserve synchronous departure persistence, inline save-listener navigation, and entry-bound submissions with visit-bound notices. TASK states: "Coalesce edits using the existing trailing-task utility: after a 120 ms quiet\ninterval, write only the latest text in that editing burst. Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save. Preserve the editor's other behavior and public interfaces." README.md states: "When close/open returns, the departed document's last accepted edit is readable\nfrom the store. A close/open request retires its previous save badge immediately."

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R02 [Event relation]
Update the accepting editor's in-memory text synchronously, then enqueue persistence using the existing trailing-task utility with a 120 ms quiet interval. Bind delayed work to the accepting document rather than consulting the later selection. Preserve editing without a selection as a no-op and allow empty text. src/editor.js contains "if (!current) return;" and "current.text = text;". TASK requires: "Subsequent bursts\nmust continue to save." The internal ownership structure may vary if these observable requirements hold.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R03 [Event relation]
Retire a consumed batch before invoking persistence so nested flushing cannot consume it twice and edits accepted by an inline listener establish independent pending work. Preserve src/trailing-task.js ordering: "    handle = null;\n    const args = pending;\n    pending = null;\n    if (args !== null) work(...args);" Do not add completion cleanup that erases a callback-enqueued batch.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R04 [Event relation]
On departure, capture the old editor resources, revoke current ownership, detach its badge, and complete old-view clearing before flushing its pending persistence, or protect any remaining effects against newer navigation. Flush before reading a replacement document. Recheck navigation request authority after callback-capable persistence before installing a destination. README.md states: "Reopening a document restores its saved text in a new editor visit." It also states: "Navigation precedence is\nordered by request start: a request that starts later wins even when an earlier\nrequest returns afterward." src/save-status.js requires that the departing badge "must produce no further output, including during that\n// navigation call." Cleanup must use captured departing resources so it cannot detach or erase a successor's resources or edits.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R05 [Event relation]
At submission entry, capture the originating visit and its document/text snapshot before persistence can invoke integrations. Persist the accepted text before archive capture, then create and return exactly one receipt even if persistence navigates or accepts further edits. README.md states: "`submit()` accepts the document and latest text selected at its call entry." It further requires: "Accepted text\nmust be persisted before the archive captures the receipt. Later edits or\nnavigation cannot change that receipt's document, text, or obligation to exist." Preserve the no-selection null result without creating a receipt.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R06 [Preservation]
Authorize submission notice output using the exact originating visit after callback-capable persistence; receipt validity and notice permission have separate lifetimes. README.md states: "Its visible submission notice belongs only\nto the editor visit that accepted the action: it may appear only if that same\nvisit is still active when the notice is emitted." It also states: "Reopening the same document\ncreates a different visit. Any navigation clears the previous submission notice." An uninterrupted submit must display its receipt and leave editing usable. Do not use document-ID equality to represent visit identity or infer authority from receipt contents.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R07 [Preservation]
Preserve synchronous workspace interfaces, store event/revision semantics, live status filtering, subscription cleanup, renderer argument shapes, and immutable archive snapshots with copied listings. src/save-status.js filters with "if (event.id === id) renderStatus(event);" src/receipt-archive.js contains "const receipt = Object.freeze({ id, text });" and "list() { return receipts.map(receipt => ({ ...receipt })); }," Preserve disposal ordering from src/workspace.js: "return { ...navigation, dispose() { stop(); navigation.close(); } };" Keep preview behavior separate: TASK states "The adjacent search preview is outside this maintenance change." src/search-preview.js uses "const task = createTrailingTask(query => publish({ query }), 40, timers);" and "hide() { task.cancel(); },".

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R08 [Exclusion]
Do not generalize departure flushing to contracts that explicitly discard pending work, require persistent buffer banks merely because documents persist, or introduce callbacks from output sinks. README.md states: "Render functions and the receipt archive are output\nsinks and never call back into the workspace." A final installation guard alone does not protect stale clearing effects after store callbacks; complete those effects first or validate their authority.

e0b6dc8fdf015a24bccb7cb67ed4d56a59cca6021dac99fc3ad8687055b35a01:R09 [Verification]
Check timer resetting, no write before 120 ms of quiet, one latest-text write per burst, later successful bursts, empty text, and no-selection editing. With pending edits, exercise switch, same-document reopen, close, and dispose; verify before-return persistence, fresh reads, and immediate badge retirement. Trigger nested open or close from timer-, departure-, and submission-driven store notifications, and edit the resulting visit; verify later navigation wins, successor output survives, and callback-enqueued work saves independently without duplicate consumption. During submit, independently verify the entry snapshot, persistence before capture, exactly one returned receipt, notice suppression after navigation or same-document reopening, uninterrupted notice output, and subsequent editing. Check no-selection submission and unchanged preview delay, hide cancellation, and later-query usability. These checks derive from TASK and public source obligations, not from the acceptance verdict.
